column1: # Version strings for install-voice.sh's reader and proto.ParseVersion (node/proto/compat.go).
# One case per line: EXPECTED <TAB> INPUT. EXPECTED is `ok MAJOR MINOR PATCH` or `reject`.
# INPUT is the string with every byte outside printable ASCII, and space, `\` and `%`, written as a
# three-digit octal escape (\040 is a space); an empty INPUT is the empty string.
# Read by scripts/test-install-voice.sh (shell reader against EXPECTED) and by
# test/voiceinstall (proto.ParseVersion against EXPECTED and against the shell reader).
# The firmware repository carries an identical copy beside its copy of the harness.
